entry.name: rnbo_in~
entry.description: Indexed signal inlet to RNBO. In the exported code, creates a logical input channel for an external audio source.

arguments.name: index
arguments.description: Eachobject requires an index number, beginning with, and creates an audio input channel in the RNBO patcher. In Max, this creates corresponding inlets to theobject for signal input. In the exported code, this creates a logical input for an external audio source.
